overall_assessment: All 28 packet entries were read in full: administrative study-year values survive in every plan, including all 12 random controls, and semester removal breaks the literature-list sentence in four plans. No confirmed personal-data leaks were found: phone flags concern numeric identifiers in reference URLs, while name_like flags concern organisations, places, technical terms, titles and reference authors rather than institutional staff. Literature authors, publication years and government-document dates are generally preserved; the Richards removed span reflects empty-parenthesis cleanup rather than clear loss of author content.

findings.description: All 28 anonymized plans retain a standalone four-digit year immediately below Studieår. These are administrative course-plan year fields, not publication or subject-matter years, and must be removed under the rubric. The same defect occurs in every random control, so it is not restricted to flagged courses; the pre-pass admin_date patterns miss this label/value layout.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R has no FHS institution handler. .anon_generic() removes academic-year ranges, season/year combinations and years after selected administrative keywords, but does not recognize a single year under the Studieår label.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an FHS handler or a narrowly anchored generic rule matching a Studieår label followed by a standalone four-digit year on the next line, removing the year while preserving adjacent fields. Add regression cases for this multiline layout and for publication years that must remain.

findings.evidence: Gjeldende litteraturliste for finner du i Leganto
findings.description: Four plans, including two random controls, contain this malformed prose sentence after a semester/year value is removed. Removing the administrative semester is correct, but leaving for directly before finner damages the surrounding sentence; this is running prose rather than a harmless empty administrative label.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The season/year rules in R/anonymize.R::.anon_generic() remove only the semester value. The subsequent cleanup handles bare Pensumliste for lines, but not the FHS sentence Gjeldende litteraturliste for <semester> finner du i Leganto.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a narrowly scoped cleanup after semester removal that rewrites Gjeldende litteraturliste for finner du i Leganto to Gjeldende litteraturliste finner du i Leganto, preserving the literature-list pointer. Cover both year-before-season and season-before-year forms in regression cases.
